ssz_progressive_container_deserializatio.highlight: Progressive containers: consensus moving toward reinstating hard limits at SSZ layer, not state transition function
Proposed fix: SSZ libraries should accept optional limits natively so clients don't hard-code them manually
Potuz: hard-coded limits in unmarshalling risk consensus bug if limits change in spec but not in client code
Gloas beacon block legacy deposit field currently has no soft limit applied; needs zero-limit added

fork_choice_equivocations.highlight: Prysm counts equivocating blocks in fork choice before full validation; other clients only count valid ones per spec
Consensus: clients should count invalid equivocations in fork choice — Prysm behavior is correct, spec should be updated
DOS risk: a proposer sending many differently-signed blocks could force signature verification on each; Potuz may cap at 3

mplex_deprecation.highlight: Lighthouse merged MPlex deprecation PR last week; Teku QUIC has memory leaks being fixed, not yet production-stable
Target: deprecate MPlex before Gloas mainnet; Teku signals no blocker in principle but needs further refinement

action_items.action: Discuss optional SSZ limits in progressive list library with Eitan and spec team
Open PR to add zero-limit for legacy deposit field in Gloas beacon block
Open PR to clarify fork choice equivocation counting (invalid equivocations should count)

decisions.decision: Clients should count invalid equivocations in fork choice; Prysm behavior is correct reference
MPlex deprecation proceeds; target before Gloas mainnet, no team blocking in principle

targets.target: MPlex deprecated before Gloas mainnet upgrade
